message.content: The “best” movie of 2020 depends on who you ask, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** as the standout film of the year—winning the Academy Award for Best Picture and earning universal acclaim for its sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. Other top contenders that year included **“1917,” “Joker,” “Tenet,”** and the heartfelt animated feature **“Soul.”**
